title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium prepayment, due days, settlement hold and refund share
content:
## Scope

This table covers the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line and states, for every tier, the premium terms that govern when premium is paid, whether unpaid premium holds back a settlement, and what share of premium is refunded on cancellation before departure.

## Tier table

| Tier | Prepayment required from a cash-in-advance holder | Premium due days after binding | Settlement withheld while premium unpaid | Premium refunded on cancellation before departure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | No | 0 days | No | 0 percent |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | Yes | 14 days | Yes | 100 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | Yes | 14 days | Yes | 100 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | Yes | 14 days | Yes | 100 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | No | 30 days | Yes | 90 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Total | No | 30 days | Yes | 90 percent |

## Definitions

- **Prepayment required**: whether a cover holder whose credit status is cash in advance must pay the premium before the cover is bound.
- **Premium due days**: the calendar days after binding within which the premium is payable when prepayment does not apply.
- **Settlement withheld while premium unpaid**: whether an approved settlement is withheld while premium on the cover is unpaid.
- **Premium refunded on cancellation before departure**: the share of the premium, in whole percent, refunded when the cover is cancelled before departure.

## Basis Q&A

**A cash-in-advance holder asks about AHL CargoCare Premium. Does the prepayment requirement of this table apply?**
No. The table shows No for prepayment on AHL CargoCare Premium, so the premium falls due within the 30 days after binding shown for that tier.

**On which tiers does unpaid premium hold back an approved settlement?**
On every tier except AHL Standard Carrier Liability.

**What share is refunded on AHL CargoCare Total?**
90 percent of the premium, when the cover is cancelled before departure.
